name: Jaffna Hindu College Inventory & Departmental Ledger
description: Complete multi-department inventory audit and ledger consolidation system for Jaffna Hindu College. Contains Master Inventory aggregation (1,741 items across 64 book columns), Responsible Person directory, and 18 Departmental Books (Admin, ICT, Physics, Bio Lab, Chemistry, Hostel, Sports, Arts, Tech Labs, Mahinthothaya, Photography) with ledger balances, physical on-hand counts, and surplus/deficiency calculations.
